SELECT us.user_selection_id AS userSelectionId, us.user_id AS userId, us.game_id AS gameId, us.pattern_combo_code AS patternComboCode, us.pattern_ids AS patternIds, us.created_at AS createdAt, apr.activity_id AS instanceId, s.student_name AS studentName, s.student_no AS studentNo, s.gender AS gender, COALESCE(s.school_id, ar.school_id) AS schoolId, d.parent_id AS departmentId, s.department_id AS majorId, sc.title AS schoolName, c.title AS departmentName, d.title AS major FROM xycc_user_selection us INNER JOIN gkzh_activity_participation_record apr ON apr.module_id = us.user_selection_id AND apr.participation_type = 4 INNER JOIN ( SELECT user_id, activity_id, MAX(record_id) AS record_id FROM gkzh_activity_participation_record WHERE participation_type = 4 GROUP BY user_id, activity_id ) latest ON latest.record_id = apr.record_id LEFT JOIN gkzh_activity_game ag ON ag.game_id = us.game_id LEFT JOIN gkzh_activity_area ar ON ar.area_id = ag.area_id LEFT JOIN gkzh_student s ON s.user_id = us.user_id AND s.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN gkzh_school sc ON sc.school_id = COALESCE(s.school_id, ar.school_id) LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department d ON d.department_id = s.department_id LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department c ON c.department_id = d.parent_id
ORDER BY us.user_selection_id DESC

SELECT pc.code AS code, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.title) AS careerTitles, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT e.title) AS envTitles FROM xycc_pattern_combo pc LEFT JOIN xycc_pattern_combo_career pcc ON pcc.combo_id = pc.pattern_combo_id LEFT JOIN xycc_career c ON c.career_id = pcc.career_id LEFT JOIN xycc_pattern_combo_env pce ON pce.combo_id = pc.pattern_combo_id LEFT JOIN xycc_work_env e ON e.work_env_id = pce.env_id GROUP BY pc.code
